title: confiture schema dump-model --format json
description: The schema model confiture reads from DDL, a project's build or a live database: `SchemaModel.to_json()` under `model`, keys sorted, so the same model is the same bytes on every run. The model's shape is schema-model.schema.json.

ok.description: The envelope: the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope: the command that wrote this payload, `schema dump-model`.

parser.description: The envelope: the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds. Two dumps are byte-identical under one parser.
